تستحقرون (form X)
# تَسْتَحْقِرُونَ (tastaḥqirūna) /tas.taħ.qi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
# تُسْتَحْقَرُونَ (tustaḥqarūna) /tus.taħ.qa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
